messages.subject: Tipco Asphalt | Road infrastructure, decarbonization and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Tipco Asphalt Leadership Team,

Tipco Asphalt's role in road infrastructure and industrial materials creates a strong fit with my experience in regulated operations, ESG and energy transition.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring practical experience supporting renewable-energy transition, carbon-data readiness, regulator engagement and community-sensitive operations. I understand how sustainability in industrial businesses depends on credible evidence, operating ownership and trusted institutions.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Tipco Asphalt-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
